{{Infobox Location |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW Brazen Beak.png |Screenshot TotK= File:TotK Brazen Beak.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |inhab= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= [[Nekk]] |TotK= [[Kheel]], [[Nekk]] }} |items= |related= |season= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Brazen Beak||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring [[Armor Shop]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Features and Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Descriptions BotW}} The Brazen Beak is the resident [[Armor Shop]] of [[Rito Village]]. It is operated by [[Nekk]], who stands at the front desk and sells wares. In addition to this, [[Huck]] beckons in customers from outside the Armor Shop, where he advertises the [[Snowquill Set]] sold inside. The Brazen Beak makes its [[Armor]] pieces with the feathers that [[Rito]] molt when seasons change. When [[Link]] makes a purchase from the Brazen Beak, Nekk will thank him for doing so. Should Link buy the Armor Shop's entire stock, Nekk remarks that he is going on a shopping spree. If Link speaks to Nekk after buying the entire Snowquill Set, Nekk suggests that he buy another to [[Hateno Dye|Dye]] at the [[Kochi Dye Shop]]. ====Wares and Pricing==== {{Wares|game= BotW |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Snowquill Headdress |price= 1000 |stock= 1 |description= A Rito accessory made from snow-bird feathers. It's adorned with a ruby, a gem that harnesses the power of fire to make cold climates more tolerable. }} |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Snowquill Tunic |price= 600 |stock= 1 |description= Lined with molted Rito feathers, this tunic was made by Rito artisans for Hylians visiting cold climates. The feathers are stacked in each layer to retain body heat. }} |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Snowquill Trousers |price= 550 |stock= 1 |description= The Rito sell these trousers to Hylians in Rito Village. The inside is lined with Rito feathers, so they excel at retaining body heat. }} }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== Since the blizzard over [[Rito Village]] started, [[Kheel]] has taken over the Brazen Beak. The [[Armor Shop]] sells warm [[Armor]] to travelers intending to traverse the [[Hebra Mountains]]. After Link has completed the [[Main Quest]] "[[Tulin of Rito Village]]" and the adult [[Rito]] return to the village, [[Nekk]] is able to come back to the shop. Kheel will stick around the Shop to help out, even though she is not in charge of sales anymore. ====Wares and Pricing==== {{Wares|game= TotK |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Snowquill Headdress |price= 650 |stock= 1 |description= A Rito accessory made from snow-bird feathers. It's adorned with a ruby, a gem that harnesses the power of fire to make cold climates more tolerable. }} |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Snowquill Tunic |price= 500 |stock= 1 |description= Lined with molted Rito feathers, this tunic was made by Rito artisans for Hylians visiting cold climates. The feathers are stacked in each layer to retain body heat. }} |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Snowquill Trousers |price= 1000 |stock= 1 |description= The Rito sell these trousers to Hylians in Rito Village.
